messages:
maya_cs: Hey team — kicking off Caspian onboarding. Main goals: integrate Redwood embeddings for search, hit initial latency SLOs, and enable self-serve for their support agents. Can we align stakeholders, success criteria, and a rough timeline? @olivia_pm @raj_engineering

olivia_pm: Thanks Maya. I'll own product acceptance criteria. Can we get an internal timeline by EOD Wed? Proposed stakeholders: Product (Olivia), Eng (Raj / Zane), Support (Tom), CS (Maya). Legal/Compliance TBD.

raj_engineering: I'll take infra + perf. Quick Q: target SLOs? p50/p95? Also need to know whether they want hosted or dedicated for pilot.

maya_cs: Customer asked for <=300ms p50 and <700ms p95 to start. We'll recommend Hosted for quick POC, Dedicated if they need strict isolation.

zane_se: I'll run the integration POC. Need Caspian API keys + a 1k-row sample dataset. @maya_cs can you request dataset access? I also suggest a staging Dedicated pool for week 2 if they want to stress test.

tom_support: I'll create an onboarding playbook and triage runbook. Also recommend a dedicated #caspian-ops channel for incidents during pilot.

maya_cs: Timeline proposal: kickoff call Mon (3 business days), POC ready in 10 business days, pilot weeks 3-4, production move end of month 2. Weekly check-ins (Fri 30m). If pilot stalls >4 weeks we flag renewal risk.

olivia_pm: Success criteria to include in the kickoff doc: 1) retrieval/embedding quality >= their current baseline using eval-set A, 2) latency within SLO on 80%+ queries, 3) cost per 1k tokens within the budget range we confirm today. Acceptance owners: Olivia (product), Raj (perf), Maya (CS).

raj_engineering: Risks: potential compliance/HIPAA requirement — need legal signoff; also autoscaling behavior under burst traffic. I will request a Dedicated trial and run synthetic spike tests.

onboard-bot: New onboarding doc created: https://redwood.atlassian.com/caspian/onboarding-1835004321 — includes checklist, runbook template, and contact list.

maya_cs: Quick checklist (first pass):
```
- collect API keys & creds
- set up staging environment
- upload sample dataset
- run initial eval (eval-suite-v2)
- perf baseline & p95/p50 measurement
- support playbook & escalation matrix
- monitoring/tracing enabled (per-route latency dashboards)
```
Who owns which item?

olivia_pm: I'll own acceptance criteria, customer-facing success metrics, and post-pilot survey.

raj_engineering: I'll own staging env, perf baseline, and synthetic spike tests.

zane_se: I'll own API integration, sample dataset ingestion, and pairing with their engineers.

tom_support: I'll own the support playbook, on-call rota for pilot, and runbook for common errors.

maya_cs: Perfect. I'll schedule the kickoff calendar invite and add the stakeholders. Also will collect data access and legal TODOs. Weekly status notes will be posted in the onboarding doc. Thanks all :thumbsup:

zane_se: One more ask — can we get a short list of 3 representative queries from Caspian to prioritize eval?

maya_cs: On it. I'll email them today and drop examples in the doc. :smiley:
